method: Three matched repetitions per binary, execution order before/after, after/before, before/after. Each invocation uses the permanent benchmark all runner with one repetition (snapshot-first scope order in both binaries). All samples retained. No own compilation during timed runs; shared host may have other workloads.
baseline: Committed runtime exported with git archive; copied current Cargo.lock and identical benchmark instrumentation. The initial unlocked build was stopped. A --locked build then incorrectly reused a stale library, detected by the historical-pack correctness gate. The library was explicitly invalidated and rebuilt before measurement. Both rejected attempts are excluded.
